body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and impose -1 on the target's next Success Die before your next turn.

surges.html: Suppress its next 1 point of cover bonus until the start of your next turn.
The target cannot make movement Reactions until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Combo - Breaker
rider.html: If you hit a creature that has declared a defensive Reaction to this Action, gain 1 additional Combo.
